requirements.text: 6 12 years of experience in backend software engineering, preferably within fintech, healthtech, or other data-intensive environments.
Strong hands-on experience with Node.js, Express, JavaScript, and TypeScript for developing scalable backend applications and services.
Proven expertise in PostgreSQL, including database design, complex queries, data modeling, optimization, and transaction management.
Own critical product initiatives end-to-end, from requirements and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Break down ambiguous business and technical problems into executable tasks and independently drive solutions to production.
Make sound architectural and engineering design decisions that improve backend scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability.
Design and develop robust REST APIs, backend services, integrations, and distributed systems supporting critical business workflows.
Collaborate closely with the CTO, product teams, and non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements and influence product direction.
Work effectively in an early-stage startup environment, taking high ownership and operating with minimal layers of management or engineering support.
Identify and implement improvements to engineering tools, development processes, testing practices, and deployment workflows to increase team productivity.
Experience with fintech/payments, healthcare claims, revenue cycle management, senior care, or AI-powered applications is highly preferred.
